title: CSM browse suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority browser-session preferences for the csm-browse namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only presentation-level session preferences are configurable; ports, CDP endpoints, tokens, credentials, container settings, origins, cookies, network policy, and browser hardening are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

viewport.description: Preferred capture viewport profile; never changes container, network, or security settings.

screenshotQuality.description: Preferred screenshot quality; never changes destinations, retention contracts, or upload ownership.

cleanupAgeHours.description: Maximum age in hours for session artifact cleanup sweeps; a bounded preference only, never a deletion authorization.
